newsitem.title: USA: U.S. WHEAT WEEKLY EXPORT SALES HIGHLIGHTS -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. WHEAT WEEKLY EXPORT SALES HIGHLIGHTS -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 765,100 metric tons (MT) were one-fifth below the previous week, but one-fifth above the 4-week average. Major Increases were recorded for Egypt (215,100 MT), Pakistan (174,900 MT), unknown destinations (165,900 MT), Japan (44,200 MT), and the Philippines (40,600 MT).

Exports of 658,800 MT were 17 percent more than the prior week and 13 percent more than the 4-week average. The primary recipients were Egypt (165,600 MT), Iraq (52,100 MT), Pakistan (49,900 MT), South Korea (45,700 MT), and Israel (44,600 MT).
